mismatches.say: Part A pays bodily injury and property damage you're legally responsible for. Insureds include you or a family member in any auto, and anyone using your covered auto.

mismatches.say: Three exclusions matter. First, public or livery use, including time logged into a ride-share app as a driver. Share-the-expense car pools and volunteer use are not excluded.

mismatches.say: The answer is time logged into a ride-share app as a driver. Share-the-expense car pools and volunteer use are not excluded.

mismatches.say: Broad form pays regardless of fault, and waives the deductible if the driver was not substantially at fault. Standard collision may also be offered: you pay the deductible either way.

mismatches.say: Sam buys a second car Monday. No auto on his policy has collision. Wednesday, before calling his insurer, he backs into a pole. Thursday, he asks for collision. Is he covered?

mismatches.say: Part D also pays transportation expenses with no deductible: up to thirty dollars a day, to nine hundred dollars. Thirty times thirty is nine hundred.
mismatches.heard: Part D also pays transportation expenses with no deductible, up to $30 a day to $900. Thirty times thirty is $900.

mismatches.say: Now endorsements. Miscellaneous Type Vehicle typically covers motor homes, motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles, dune buggies and golf carts. Snowmobiles use a separate endorsement.

mismatches.say: Extended Non-Owned removes the regular-use exclusion for liability, and med pay if bought. It fits someone who regularly drives an employer's car.
